source: ADR-0006 revision 5.2 (section 17.10 item 21; M05 wave 3, orchestrator ruling I-14), transcribed from the ruling's text, never from the code under test: WorkspaceView.proposal is the trust proposal the server builds for the working directory (the manifest's request intersected with the profile's latest snapshot). It is omitted when there is none, so every earlier inspect workspace document is unchanged.
subject: inspect-workspace

views.what: an untrusted manifest root: the proposal is written, with the manifest's access digest
the smallest proposal: the whole profile (empty lists are omitted, background_work false is omitted)
a manifest-less root: no proposal, the key is absent
no workspace root: no proposal, the key is absent

decision_scope.source: ADR-0006 revision 5.2 (section 17.10 item 22; review M05-W3-R01), transcribed from the ruling's text, never from the code under test: a pending WidenPolicy create record's inspect decisions view gains scope {profile_id, profile_revision, pairs, environments, capabilities, lock_behavior}, read from its decision basis fixed at creation (the pinned profile revision's snapshot), never a fresh catalog read. Every list is written. The key is omitted for every other record, so every existing decision view is byte-identical; a typed struct inside the untyped decision view, no schema change.

views.what: a pending personal default create pinned at revision 2 of dev: the scope is written, every list included
a create whose pinned revision has no capability: the empty list is written, never omitted
an extend_scope record: its action is the added authority, no scope, the key is absent
a targeted resume: its policies (revision 5.1 C1), no scope, the key is absent
